note: Bag and lid running dry [0001 E1-33], [0001 E1-34], [0001 E1-37]. Short census by necessity, not by accident: at any refill of a lawfully dealt game at least 40 tiles sit in bag + lid, so a refill that deals nothing is reachable only from a census below 100 [0001 E1-37]. This fixture holds far fewer, and runs three round transitions — a lid recycle that shuffles, then a deal that stops part-way and leaves displays short, then a refill that deals nothing at all and ends the game with `exhausted` set.
